subject: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the great demo last week. As discussed, we'd love to publish a short customer case study highlighting how Lumera used Redwood to cut inference latency and reduce per-token cost on clinical summarization workloads. Attached is a working draft (lumera_case_v1.pdf) with one pull-quote from your notes.

Can you please:
- Confirm Lumera is OK with the content and the quote from your team
- Share the official Lumera logo files and brand guidelines for usage
- Tell us any mandatory legal credit line or trademark text you require
- Flag anything we should redact (no PHI will be included)

If it's easier, Marissa (cc'd) can do a quick call with your comms/legal to walk through. Goal would be publication on our site and a one-page PDF customer highlight.

Attachments: lumera_case_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumera.com>, Adrian Koh <adrian.koh@lumera.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the draft, and the team liked the framing. We're generally happy to participate but need a quick legal review and to confirm logo usage with our brand team. I attached our current brand guide and a zip of logo assets (Lumera_Brand_Guide_v2.pdf, lumera_logo_eps.zip).

Two quick asks from my side:
1) Can you anonymize one metric that mentions patient counts (we prefer an ordinal or percentage instead of raw counts) — I'll flag the exact line after legal review.
2) We typically ask for a short approval window (48-72 hrs) once we receive the final cut.

I've looped in Priya (comm ops) and Adrian (legal). They'll handle the formal signoff and any redlines.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Partnerships
Lumera Health
oliver@lumera.com

Attachments: Lumera_Brand_Guide_v2.pdf, lumera_logo_eps.zip

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumera.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage

Thanks, Oliver —

I pulled the draft into a marketing-friendly layout and replaced the inline quote with the exact phrasing you gave in the demo notes. See attached (lumera_case_v1.pdf) for context — same content, different formatting.

A couple of notes for Priya/adrian:
- We plan to include Lumera's full-color horizontal logo at the top of the one-pager and a small monochrome logo in the footer. If you prefer a different lockup or size, please advise.
- We will not include any raw PHI. The metric that currently reads "1200 patient notes processed" can be changed to ">1k patient notes" if needed.

If legal can confirm the trademark text to use under the logo (e.g., "Lumera®" or just "Lumera"), we will update immediately. Once you give the green light, we'll send a final PDF for a 72-hr approval.

Attachments: lumera_case_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Communications Manager, Marketing
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Adrian Koh <adrian.koh@lumera.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage — redlines

Hi all —

Thanks for sharing. Quick legal redlines from Lumera:
1) Replace the explicit patient count with an approximate statement (e.g., "~1k patient notes" or "over 1k") — do not publish raw patient identifiers or counts tied to specific cohorts.
2) Add the following credit line under the case study title: "Customer name and data usage provided with permission by Lumera Health."
3) Trademark use: please display "Lumera" with the ® where the logo file includes the mark. Do not alter or redraw the provided logo files.
4) Time-limited permission: Lumera grants permission to publish the case study and use the attached logos for 24 months from the date of signed approval; continued use after that requires reauthorization.

I've attached a marked-up PDF with inline comments (lumera_redlines.pdf). Once Redwood incorporates these edits, please send the final PDF back to me for signature.

Regards,
Adrian Koh
Senior Counsel, Legal
Lumera Health
adrian.koh@lumera.com

Attachments: lumera_redlines.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumera.com>, Adrian Koh <adrian.koh@lumera.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage — next steps

Thanks Adrian — that all sounds reasonable. To summarize the required edits for the final draft:
- Change "1200 patient notes processed" to "over 1k patient notes processed"
- Add the credit line exactly as you provided under the title
- Ensure the provided ® mark is used with the logo; do not alter logo files
- Include a notes box in the footer that permissions are time-limited to 24 months

Marissa — can you make these edits and regenerate the one-pager? Ben, could you confirm the internal case tag (deal id DL-2026-0947) is correct for reference? Vivek, FYI in case we need an exception beyond 24 months.

Once Marissa uploads the final PDF, I'll route it back to Adrian for signature and ask Oliver for the 72-hr final approval window.

Thanks —
Irene
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@lumera.com>, Adrian Koh <adrian.koh@lumera.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Health case study approval + logo usage — final approval

Hi Irene/Marissa —

This looks great. Adrian signed off after Marissa updated the PDF (I saw the updated footer and the credit line). I've attached a signed copy of the logo release and approval (lumera_logo_release_signed.pdf) and a DocuSign confirmation link: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/ABC12345.

Lumera grants permission to publish the one-pager on Redwood's customer stories page and to use the provided logo files per the brand guide for 24 months starting today. Please send a final live link to the published asset when it goes up.

Thanks for making the process smooth — excited to share this story together.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Partnerships
Lumera Health
oliver@lumera.com

Attachments: lumera_logo_release_signed.pdf
